scope: whole project (app/, data/, package.json, tsconfig.json); no ESLint or next.config found

findings.title: Payment secret key read in a "use client" component
findings.explanation: Checkout.tsx is a client module ("use client" on line 1) and builds an Authorization header from process.env.PAYMENT_SECRET_KEY. Env vars without the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix are undefined in the browser, so the request is sent with 'Bearer undefined' and the payment call fails. If the key were exposed to the client (for example by renaming it to NEXT_PUBLIC_), a payment secret would be public to every visitor. Only the env access pattern is present, not a hard-coded secret value, so severity is high rather than critical. Checkout is not imported anywhere in the project, but it is still a client module.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the charge call to a Server Action or Route Handler that reads PAYMENT_SECRET_KEY on the server, and have the client component call that endpoint without any credential.

findings.title: Large hero image uses plain instead of next/image
findings.explanation: The hero image (file name indicates 4000x2500) is rendered with a plain in a Next.js 14 project. It loses automatic resizing, modern formats and lazy/priority handling, and has no width/height, so it can hurt LCP and cause layout shift on the home page. The size is inferred from the file name only (the asset is not in the fixture), hence 'likely'. No no-img-element suppression or ESLint config is visible.
findings.suggested_fix: Use next/image: <Image src="/hero-4000x2500.jpg" alt="Mountains at sunrise" width={1200} height={750} priority /> (or fill with sizes).

findings.title: Page marked "use client" without using any client-only feature
findings.explanation:
The page only maps a static array to
  • elements and renders Hero. It uses no state, effects, handlers or browser APIs, so the directive is unnecessary. It also pulls Hero (and its large ) and the data module into the client bundle, and prevents the page from fetching data on the server if posts later come from a database or API. Severity is low because no server data fetching is currently blocked.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the "use client" directive so the page stays a Server Component; add the directive only to genuinely interactive leaf components.
